subject.name: Python for Data Science and AI Applications
subject.source: Syllabus/B.Tech programs/_PDF_Library/01CE/01CE0413 - Python for Data Science and AI Applications.pdf

chapters.chapter_name: Module 1: Python Programming and Object-Oriented Development
content: Introduction to Python - Basic Syntax, Data Types, Control
Structures, Functions, Modules, Error Handling - Lists, Tuples
Sets,, Dictionaries - String Manipulation, File Operations - Classes
Objects, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation - Design
Patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer), NumPy, Pandas
Matplotlib, Seaborn, scikit-learn
Data Cleaning, Preprocessing (Pandas, Data Imputation, Scaling
Encoding, Normalization, Outlier Detection), Feature Selection
Feature Extraction, Feature Engineering (scikit-learn), Exploratory
Data Analysis (EDA), Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn)

chapters.chapter_name: Module 3: Python for Machine Learning Machine Learning Basics - Supervised Learning (Linear
content: Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests), Unsupervised
Learning (K-means, PCA), Model Selection, Model Evaluation
Hyperparameter Tuning

chapters.chapter_name: Module 4: Introduction to Deep Learning and NLP
content: Image Preprocessing (Resizing, Normalization, Data
Augmentation), Neural Networks, TensorFlow, Keras - Transfer
Learning, Pretrained Models (VGG, ResNet), NLP Basics (NLTK
SpaCy), Transformer Models (BERT, GPT) - Computer Vision
(OpenCV)
Advanced Visualization in Python (Plotly, Bokeh, Dash)
Reinforcement Learning (Q-learning),, Basics of Generative
Adversarial Networks (GANs) and LLM,, Time Series Analysis
Write a Python Program to Apply Feature Selection on the Adult
Income Dataset Using Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE)
Write a Python Program to Preprocess Images and Train a CNN on
CIFAR-10 Using TensorFlow and Keras
